columns.name: age
columns.description: The age of the bank client in years.

columns.name: job
columns.description: The occupation or employment category of the bank client.

columns.name: marital
columns.description: The marital status of the bank client.

columns.name: education
columns.description: The highest reported education level of the bank client.

columns.name: default
columns.description: Indicates whether the client has credit in default.

columns.name: housing
columns.description: Indicates whether the client has a housing loan.

columns.name: loan
columns.description: Indicates whether the client has a personal loan.

columns.name: contact
columns.description: The communication method used for the most recent contact with the client.

columns.name: month
columns.description: The month in which the most recent marketing contact occurred.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.description: The day of the week on which the most recent marketing contact occurred.

columns.name: duration
columns.description: The duration of the most recent marketing contact in seconds. This value is only known after the contact has ended and is highly predictive of subscription.

columns.name: campaign
columns.description: The number of contacts made with the client during the current marketing campaign, including the most recent contact.

columns.name: pdays
columns.description: The number of days since the client was last contacted in a previous campaign. The special value 999 means the client was not previously contacted.

columns.name: previous
columns.description: The number of contacts made with the client before the current campaign, represented as one of the observed discrete count values.

columns.name: poutcome
columns.description: The outcome of the previous marketing campaign for the client.

columns.name: emp_var_rate
columns.description: The quarterly employment variation rate. Although numerically ordered, it is represented using the finite set of values observed in this dataset.

columns.name: cons_price_idx
columns.description: The monthly consumer price index, representing changes in the prices paid by consumers.

columns.name: cons_conf_idx
columns.description: The monthly consumer confidence index, representing consumer sentiment about economic conditions.

columns.name: euribor3m
columns.description: The daily three-month Euribor interest rate.

columns.name: nr_employed
columns.description: The quarterly number of employed people, expressed in thousands.

columns.name: y
columns.description: The target classification label: 1 means the client subscribed to a term deposit and 0 means the client did not subscribe.

label: y
task_description: Predict whether a bank client subscribed to a term deposit after the recorded marketing contact, using client attributes, campaign history, contact information, and economic indicators.
